subject.title: [Bug]: Matrix message read/pins CLI output renders completely blank tables

question: Should Matrix readMessages return deduplicated edited-message payloads to JSON/tool consumers, or should m.replace collapse stay display-only while preserving raw timeline-style payloads?
rationale: The blank-table bug has a clear Matrix-local owner-boundary fix, but the linked comprehensive PR also changes consumer-visible Matrix read payload semantics.

options.title: Accept Edited-Message Payloads
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99057 as the canonical fix if Matrix reads should expose final edited messages across CLI, JSON, and tool consumers.

options.title: Keep Dedup Display-Only
options.body: Land Matrix-local formatter-friendly read/pins projection but move m.replace collapse out of the shared readMessages payload contract.

options.title: Split Blank Tables From Dedup
options.body: Fix the read/pins table projection first and track edited-message deduplication as a smaller follow-up with its own contract review.

recommendation.title: Accept Edited-Message Payloads
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99057 as the canonical fix if Matrix reads should expose final edited messages across CLI, JSON, and tool consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history in Matrix plugin actions and shared CLI formatter boundaries.
